name: Page Orchard
mechanic: Repair an ordered multi-key page tree after insertions and deletions: choose a separator to promote, a sibling to borrow from, or a merge while retaining equal leaf depth and minimum occupancy.
description: Repair an ordered multi-key page tree after insertions and deletions: choose a separator to promote, a sibling to borrow from, or a merge while retaining equal leaf depth and minimum occupancy.

Split an overflowing page at either middle key. Borrow or merge an empty nonroot page; an internal deletion first chooses the predecessor or successor. Every edited page costs writes. Advancing with an unrepaired tree loses.

name: Durable Ink
mechanic: Batch durable journal records, preserve committed edits and undo provisional overlapping writes after a controlled crash; checkpoint safely before provisional edits.
description: Batch durable journal records, preserve committed edits and undo provisional overlapping writes after a controlled crash; checkpoint safely before provisional edits.

Before crashing, log every TWO update and write at least one provisional TWO value to disk. The third finite study requires a checkpoint before TWO: it writes committed ONE data and compacts the tight journal. Journal space and work are limited.
After the crash, redo surviving updates in increasing journal order, then undo TWO in reverse order. The recovered store must contain exactly ONE’s values and none of TWO’s edits.

The two-transaction recovery protocol and legal witness work remain bounded.

name: Pipeline Parade
mechanic: Issue and retire a dependency program while deciding when to broadcast results, forward same-address stores and squash a taken branch before side effects escape.
description: Issue and retire a dependency program while deciding when to broadcast results, forward same-address stores and squash a taken branch before side effects escape.

Loads may observe memory before an older same-address store retires. Forward a completed store or wait. Retire in program order, and resolve the branch before exposing younger side effects.
Retire all required instructions within the clock deadline. Taken branches squash the two fall-through instructions. Final register and memory values must match the sequential program.

name: Delta Garden
mechanic: Maintain a multiset join under insertions and deletions by choosing batches and signed delta products; applying two simultaneous changes separately or together requires different cross terms.
description: Maintain a multiset join under insertions and deletions by choosing batches and signed delta products; applying two simultaneous changes separately or together requires different cross terms.
rules: A matching key contributes left multiplicity times right multiplicity. Each epoch provides signed insert/delete deltas; retain the exact materialized join after every epoch.

Choose old, delta or new inputs for each incremental join. At least one input must be a delta. Simultaneous left/right changes require the cross product exactly once; queued terms add to the old result.
Join passes are limited. Discarding queued terms restores no work. Commit only an exact epoch result; complete all epochs to finish the study.

name: Shared Cursors
mechanic: Transform concurrent insert/delete operations against already applied remote edits so their original text intentions survive delivery order without duplicating or deleting the wrong character.
description: Transform concurrent insert/delete operations against already applied remote edits so their original text intentions survive delivery order without duplicating or deleting the wrong character.
rules: Both writers have applied their own local edit sequence to the same initial strip. Deliver the other writer’s consecutive edits in packets of at most two, using positions transformed across concurrent operations.

An insert shifts later positions; equal-position inserts place P before Q. A delete shifts later positions back; two deletes of the same character reduce the second deletion to a no-op. Packet edit two applies after edit one.
Packet allowance requires batching. Every remote edit must be delivered, with its transformed position or justified no-op, and both document strips must converge.

nearestExisting.difference: Dependency-constrained patch selection resolves authored patch conflicts. This transforms positional concurrent operations through live peer histories and must converge despite delivery order.

name: Quiet Network
mechanic: Return completion credits through a dynamically grown parent tree only after descendants and in-flight tasks have settled; an apparently idle set of workers can still have work in transit.
description: Return completion credits through a dynamically grown parent tree only after descendants and in-flight tasks have settled; an apparently idle set of workers can still have work in transit.
rules: Executing a delivered job sends child work and retains a credit obligation for each child. An idle job cannot acknowledge its parent until every child credit returns.

Group all currently ready acknowledgments from one worker to one parent worker into an envelope. Executions and envelope deliveries cost1; early small batches can exhaust the allowance. Declare completion only when all jobs and channels settle.

No amortized-cost potential coefficients: actual transferable work credits are protocol ownership records, not a charge inequality.

name: Lease Lighthouse

name: Echo Seals
mechanic: Route echo/ready evidence among honest receivers despite one sender equivocating, and deliver a value only when the protocol's collected evidence establishes agreement.
description: Route echo/ready evidence among honest receivers despite one sender equivocating, and deliver a value only when the protocol's collected evidence establishes agreement.
rules: Nodes1–3 are honest; sender0 can equivocate. Route visible signed envelopes to receivers. Count distinct authors separately for each phase and colour; duplicate signatures add no author.
An honest receiver emits one ECHO for a sender colour it received. READY requires three distinct ECHOs or two distinct READYs; delivery requires three distinct READYs at that receiver.
All honest receivers must deliver the same certified colour within the delivery budget. Irrelevant envelopes may be discarded. These finite schedules guarantee an attainable common delivery.

endless.reason: The current implementation offers three authored studies rather than a verified indefinitely varied generator.

nearestExisting.difference: Static quorum-set design does not operate echo/ready phases, author-deduplicated evidence or a Byzantine sender emitting inconsistent values. Here local evidence evolves and delivery decisions must agree.
No hidden role bluff or challenge: fault bound and public evidence rules govern distributed delivery, with one declared adversarial participant.

name: Timestamp Current

description: Advance an event-time watermark to close aggregation windows while retaining enough memory for late events permitted by each source's progress guarantee.

Publish a monotone global watermark no higher than every source’s certified bound. Close a window only when its end is at or behind that watermark; premature finality loses.
Finalizing a window releases its buffer space and sums every buffered or archived event exactly once. Limited archive spills can relieve pressure. Finish every source and window with exact totals.

name: Changing Roads
mechanic: Repair distance-vector routing after a link failure by choosing advertisements and poisoned reverse withdrawals, preventing neighbors from sustaining a bogus route through each other.
description: Repair distance-vector routing after a link failure by choosing advertisements and poisoned reverse withdrawals, preventing neighbors from sustaining a bogus route through each other.

name: Branch Archive

description: Update multiple immutable tree versions by copying only shared nodes on the changed path; retain reusable subtrees without allowing an update to corrupt an older published version.

name: Cancellation Desk
mechanic: Choose summation order and when to retain a compensation residual under finite decimal precision so small contributions survive large cancellation without overspending arithmetic work.
description: Choose summation order and when to retain a compensation residual under finite decimal precision so small contributions survive large cancellation without overspending arithmetic work.
rules: All arithmetic rounds to three significant decimal digits. Select one signed term to add or two to form a rounded subtotal. Every original term must contribute exactly once.

Ordinary addition costs one work unit; compensated addition costs two and keeps a separately rounded lost-part correction. Pairing costs one and creates a new rounded term. Choose grouping and order before information disappears.
Report only after consuming every term. The final rounded accumulator plus correction must equal the exact signed total. The work allowance prevents repairing arbitrary poor choices.

controls: Select one term for an ordinary or compensated add, or two terms for a rounded pair; report the final sum after consuming every term. Use touch taps, or Tab with Enter/Space; arrow keys adjust any labeled native range.

endless.reason: The current implementation offers three authored studies rather than a verified indefinitely varied generator.

name: Bracket Ferry

description: Choose midpoint, secant or Newton root probes while preserving an exact sign-changing interval; fast tangents may leave the bracket, while bisection spends more probes.

Retain the half whose endpoints still have opposite signs. Sign and width comparisons use exact fractions, even when the displayed decimal approximation is short.
Accept only a completed bracket no wider than the target, within the probe allowance. A wrong half, out-of-bracket tangent or premature acceptance loses; an exact root wins immediately.
Complete three finite studies. Reset challenge retries this study; Restart game begins the campaign again. Optional generated challenges bank finished-study scores until a loss or you end the run.
controls: Choose midpoint, secant or Newton; choose a Newton endpoint, compute the probe, retain the sign-preserving half and accept the finished bracket. Use touch taps, or Tab with Enter/Space; arrow keys adjust any labeled native range.

endless.difficultyCap: Bounded program, event, key, edit or geometric state; seed-driven transition data continues to vary after study three.

name: Pivot Gallery
mechanic: Pivot among feasible corners of a small linear optimization problem, choosing an improving entering direction and its minimum-ratio limiting constraint while avoiding degenerate wasted pivots.
description: Pivot among feasible corners of a small linear optimization problem, choosing an improving entering direction and its minimum-ratio limiting constraint while avoiding degenerate wasted pivots.
rules: Keep every resource inequality feasible. Release one active corner boundary and choose a direction along the other. Each forward blocking ratio is shown; pivot only as far as the earliest limiting resource.
Each pivot spends one unit. A farther blocking choice crosses a nearer boundary and loses. Zero-length tied pivots can change the active basis but still cost work.
